title: PumpWizard Runner 0.2.0.dev121 — Clearer Orders and Decisions
summary: Add recorded order activity and saved candidate charts, clear summaries, searchable filters, expandable details and CSV exports to Activity.

Expand an order to inspect its recorded receipt, exact SOL fees and wallet changes, mint and signature; copy identifiers or open its Explorer link and full token chart. CSV exports include all matching records across pages.

Decisions combines the selected scope into one workspace. A candidate market map plots saved market cap against liquidity, distinguishing enter signals from do-not-enter decisions and shading the selected strategy entry range when available. Reason counts, search, time/strategy/reason filters, sorting and expandable saved inputs make the latest candidate decisions easier to inspect. Token charts may include later market data and remain separate from the saved inputs. An inspected token stays open when its latest saved decision refreshes.

Both views use consistent headings, token identity icons, compact summaries and labelled mobile record cards. Scope changes reset filters to that session or strategy; archived order attribution is retained. Unknown receipts, fees, timestamps and candidate inputs stay explicit rather than becoming fabricated values or chart points.

The final four Activity checks passed against the updated frontend, covering desktop/mobile charts, scope isolation, filters, pagination, CSV exports, copying, exact fee formatting, missing inputs, full token charts and keeping inspected decisions open during refresh. Package, backup and installed-service evidence is recorded separately in output/dev121-activity-verification.json; this draft does not claim its completion.
